title: MirageRdpPluginConfig
description: Configuration for the Mirage RD Gateway policy plugin (Priority 5). Loaded once at plugin registration/service start from a mode-0600 JSON file on the Gateway host — never from the registry, never with a secret VALUE inline (see proxy_shared_secret_env_var).

mirage_api_url.description: Base URL of mirage-api, e.g. https://mirage-api.internal:8000 — the plugin calls GET {mirage_api_url}/route.

gateway_listener_id.description: Stable identifier for this specific RD Gateway listener, used as the second field of the canonical match_key: RDP|<gateway_listener_id>|<client_ip>|<principal>.

client_cert_path.description: Path to this Gateway's own mTLS client certificate (PEM), issued by step-ca under the BROKER_CLIENT profile.

client_key_path.description: Path to the private key matching client_cert_path. Must be readable only by the service account the plugin runs under.

root_ca_path.description: Path to the trusted step-ca root certificate used to verify mirage-api's TLS certificate.

client_cert_serial.description: This Gateway's own certificate serial, sent as X-Mirage-Client-Cert-Serial — must match client_cert_path's actual serial (validated at plugin startup, not merely trusted).

proxy_shared_secret_env_var.description: Name of an environment variable (set on the service account, never in this file) holding the X-Mirage-Proxy-Auth shared secret value — this file never contains a secret value itself.

timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout calling /route. Appendix H.3's own NLA-compatible flow requires this to resolve well within RD Gateway's own connection-authorization timeout budget.

fail_safe_target.description: What to do when /route is unreachable or times out — ENDPOINT (fail safe to the real employee desktop, matching the HTTP/SSH brokers' own documented fail-safe) or DENY (refuse the connection outright). Never SANDBOX — a broker must never fail open into the observed environment.

event_log_source.description: Windows Event Log source name this plugin registers and logs decision/audit events under (install-mirage-rdp-plugin.ps1 creates it).
